name: heroic-decky-plugin
description: Decky Loader plugin: browse and launch your Heroic Games Launcher library (GOG + Epic) from the Steam Deck Quick Access menu.

scripts.pack: npm run build && rm -rf pkg heroic-library.zip && mkdir -p pkg/heroic-library && cp plugin.json main.py package.json README.md LICENSE pkg/heroic-library/ && cp -r py_modules dist assets pkg/heroic-library/ && rm -f pkg/heroic-library/dist/*.map && find pkg -name __pycache__ -type d -exec rm -rf {} + && (cd pkg && zip -r ../heroic-library.zip heroic-library) && rm -rf pkg
